analytics.name: Analytic 1812
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Abuse Accessibility Features by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: AccessibilityService receiving events from dc(source_app) > $AccessibilityTargetThreshold$ distinct apps INCLUDING apps IN $TargetAppList$ — broad monitoring across apps distinguishes malware from single-purpose assistive tech]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Approved screen readers, assistive tech. Minimal. Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 5 distinct source apps — monitors broadly vs narrowly.
Banking, auth, enterprise SSO, SMS app packages.
